title: Tame the overhang field: rare, deliberate cliff zones, true-surface caves, worm cave mouths
player_outcome: Walking the surface is predictable. No random fins, floating blobs, pits or trenches in normal terrain. Overhangs and cliffs appear only in rare mountain, jungle or snow cliff zones. Cave entrances are proper holes into hillsides, not long gullies along the ground.
design: Add src/Strata.Core/WorldGen/Fields/TerrainTuning.cs (algorithm constants, not content): OverhangWavelength 48, OverhangOctaves 2, OverhangYStretch 0.8, BaseAmp 0.6, RuggedAmp 1.4, CliffAmp 11, CliffMaskWavelength 520, CliffMaskLow/High 0.60/0.78, WormMouthFraction 0.3, MouthPitch -0.45..-0.30 for 3 segments, BuriedWormDepth 14..40.

WorldPlan: add Grid2D Cliffs (HeightStep). BiomeRelief.Apply fills it: cliff = SmoothStep(0.60, 0.78, cliffMask01(x,z)) × blended affinity (region weights × ReliefSpec.Cliffs, lerped to 0.8 by the mountain mask) × spawnCalm × land, then Blur(2).

TerrainField: _overhang = NoiseField.Create(seeds, "overhang", 48f, Fbm, 2). Add Cliff(x,z) => _plan.Cliffs.SampleSmooth. Change the static to OverhangAmplitude(float rug, float cliff) => 0.6 + 1.4*rug + 11*cliff. New Density(x,y,z,h,amp) adds _overhang.Sample(x, y*0.8f, z)*amp inside |d| < amp+1. Outside cliff zones amp is at most 2 cells, so ∂d/∂y stays negative (a pure heightfield with sub-cell jitter). Inside cliff zones amp up to 11.6 gives steep walls with occasional undercuts only at maximum gradient.

ChunkGenContext: add per-padded-column arrays Cliff[] and OverhangAmp[], computed in the constructor. GlobalDensityPass uses ctx.OverhangAmp[col] for its band and Density call. WorldPlan.RaiseTerrainColumnTops uses TerrainField.OverhangAmplitude(rug, cliff) (pass the TerrainField from WorldGenerator).

Caves respect the true surface: in CaveGenerationPass.CarveNoiseCaves use sd = (h - ctx.OverhangAmp[col]) - wy - spawnGuard. Pass 1 guarantees solid below that level, so noise tunnels and cracks keep at least 5 cells of roof even where the 3D field dips below the 2D height (today sd uses the raw 2D height).

Worms in CaveGenerationPass.Plan: keep 190 (cabins need tunnels). About 30% are mouths: they start at SurfaceHeight - 1 and their first 3 segments pitch -0.45..-0.30, cutting a hole into the hillside; then the existing shallow meander. Today every worm starts at surface+2 with pitch -0.06..-0.12, leaving a ~50-cell open trench. The rest start buried at SurfaceHeight - rng.Range(14, 40). The mouth roll comes from the same rng stream; the order change is fine under the version bump.
PlanHasher: hash the Cliffs grid (rounded) for drift detection.
Re-pin golden hashes. Stay on GenVersion 10 if P1b-02 has not been pushed and played; otherwise bump to 11.
